description: Dashboard is the Schema for the dashboards API.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and may reject unrecognized values. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: DashboardSpec defines the desired state of the Dashboard module.

components.description:
Components is a snapshot of DSC component availability, projected by
the ODH Operator onto this CR.

additionalProperties.description:
ComponentAvailability represents a DSC component's availability state
as projected by the orchestrator.

deploymentMode.description:
DeploymentMode controls how BFF modules are deployed.
Sidecar (default): modules run as containers in the main dashboard pod.
Standalone: each module gets its own Deployment, Service, and RBAC.

gateway.description: Gateway configures the ingress point for the dashboard.

managementState.description:
ManagementState controls whether the operator actively manages the
component (Managed) or removes it (Removed).

modules.description:
Modules contains per-module override configuration. Map keys are
module names as defined in the controller's internal module registry.

additionalProperties.description:
ModuleOverride allows the orchestrator or admin to override the
automatic dependency-based module enablement decision.

state.description:
State overrides automatic module enablement.
If empty or omitted, the controller uses dependency resolution.

observability.description: Observability configures the observability stack integration.

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether the Perses proxy module is deployed.

persesService.description:
PersesService identifies the target Perses service to proxy to.
Required when Enabled is true.

status.description: DashboardStatus defines the observed state of the Dashboard.

conditions.description: Conditions is the set of condition observations for this module.

items.description:
Condition represents an observation of a module's state at a point in time.
Module controllers set conditions to communicate health signals to the
orchestrator and to human operators.

lastTransitionTime.description:
LastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one
status to another.

message.description:
Message is a human-readable description providing details about the
condition's last transition.

observedGeneration.description:
ObservedGeneration is the .metadata.generation of the resource that
the condition was set based upon. If this does not match the resource's
current generation, the condition is likely stale.

reason.description:
Reason is a programmatic, one-word CamelCase identifier for the
condition's last transition, suitable for machine consumption.

severity.description:
Severity indicates whether this condition represents an error or is
purely informational. Empty string (default) indicates error severity.

status.description: Status is the status of the condition (True, False, Unknown).

type.description: Type is the condition type, e.g. ConditionTypeReady, ConditionTypeDegraded.

distribution.description: Distribution reports the product distribution identity.

moduleStatuses.description: ModuleStatuses reports the deployment state of each module.

additionalProperties.description: ModuleStatus reports the current state of a single module.

phase.description: ModulePhase represents the deployment lifecycle of an individual module.

reason.description: Reason is a one-word CamelCase explanation for the current phase.

observedGeneration.description:
ObservedGeneration is the most recent .metadata.generation observed
by the controller. It allows consumers to determine whether the
controller has processed the latest spec changes.

phase.description: Phase is the top-level lifecycle phase of the module.

releases.description: Releases is the list of deployed component releases.

items.description: ComponentRelease describes a single software component's release metadata.

name.description: Name is the component name, used as the merge key in lists.

repoUrl.description: RepoURL is the source repository URL for this component release.

version.description: Version is the semantic version of the component.

url.description:
URL is the externally-reachable dashboard URL (last known good).
This value persists across transient route failures — consumers must
check the Ready condition before relying on this endpoint.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: persesService must be specified when observability is enabled
